Indian stock markets show mixed signals amid global developments

Indian stock markets experienced a mixed trading session, with the BSE Sensex opening over 300 points higher and the Nifty50 surpassing 24,100. This movement occurred against a backdrop of ongoing US-Iran peace talks, which influenced oil prices. Analysts provided various stock recommendations, with some anticipating modest gains despite global uncertainties.
